# Tool runner

You MUST use your shell tool for this task. Run exactly this one command:

    printf 'MARKER-%s' 'LIVE'

Then reply with one short sentence that reports the command's output verbatim
(quote the exact text the command printed). Do not run any other commands, and
do not guess the output — report only what the tool actually returned.
